title: Hibike! Euphonium 3
synopsis:
With the ensemble contest behind them, the members of the Kitauji High School concert band now aim to win a gold medal at the national competition. For third-year club president Kumiko Oumae and her friends, it is their last chance before graduation. Filled with anticipation and anxiety, Kumiko worries if she can successfully lead the band.

Amid her struggles, Kumiko encounters transfer student Mayu Kuroe. From her gentle demeanor to her talented euphonium skills, Mayu was a member of the Seira Girls' School concert band—a regular at nationals. While Mayu is friendly, Kumiko cannot help but have an indescribable feeling from their meeting.

As new members arrive and plans are set in motion, the club, with an insatiable hunger for a gold medal, learns what it truly takes to propel themselves to reach the national level.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Con el concurso de conjunto detrás de ellos, los miembros de la banda de concierto de la escuela secundaria Kitauji ahora aspiran a ganar una medalla de oro en la competencia nacional. Para la presidenta del club de tercer año, Kumiko Oumae, y sus amigos, es su última oportunidad antes de graduarse. Llena de anticipación y ansiedad, a Kumiko le preocupa poder liderar con éxito la banda.

En medio de sus luchas, Kumiko se encuentra con la estudiante transferida Mayu Kuroe. Desde su comportamiento amable hasta sus talentosas habilidades con el bombardino, Mayu era miembro de la banda de conciertos de Seira Girls' School, habitual en los nacionales. Si bien Mayu es amigable, Kumiko no puede evitar tener un sentimiento indescriptible tras su encuentro.

A medida que llegan nuevos miembros y se ponen en marcha los planes, el club, con un hambre insaciable de una medalla de oro, aprende lo que realmente se necesita para impulsarse y alcanzar el nivel nacional.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: New Euphonium
episodes_data.description: A new year is starting at Kitauji Kyoto Prefectural High School, and that means clubs are clamoring to recruit new members. The concert band welcomes newcomers and sets their goals for the season. Will they choose to fight for gold at Nationals?

episodes_data.title: Triangle Syncopation
episodes_data.description: Taki decides to let the band executives choose their competition piece this year. The leadership deliberates on this decision while trying to get the rest of the band ready to perform at the Sunrise Festival.

episodes_data.title: Blue Prelude
episodes_data.description: The concert band begins taking itself very seriously to give itself the best chance possible of winning gold at Nationals. Unfortunately, the intense environment has some of the new recruits discouraged and intimidated.

episodes_data.title: Etude with You
episodes_data.description: The day of the Sunrise Festival finally arrives, and it`s time for the concert band to have their first performance of the year. Proximity to other schools and bands brings some of Motomu`s family issues to light.

episodes_data.title: Twilight for Two
episodes_data.description: Now that she`s well into her third-year, Kumiko is now facing pressure from teachers and parents alike to choose what she`s doing after high school. Concert band members form groups to attend the Agata Festival, but Kumiko has other plans.

episodes_data.title: Wavering Dissonance
episodes_data.description: The Prefecturals are coming up and that means the first of many auditions for the members of the concert band. Mayu is still hesitant to audition despite reassurance from the others. Some of Taki`s choices for the competition confuse members.

episodes_data.title: Summer Fermata
episodes_data.description: Members of the concert band are given a brief, three-day summer break that quickly fills with plans of all sorts. Some of the third-years attend an event to gather information on different colleges and plan their futures.

episodes_data.title: Melancholy Ostinato
episodes_data.description: The three-day summer camp has begun, and members of the concert band are faced with a rigorous training regimen. Mayu hesitates to audition yet again, afraid that she`ll take the soli part from Kumiko. Motomu speaks to Midori in private.

episodes_data.title: Dissonant Tuning
episodes_data.description: Mayu taking the soli part has made the concert band uneasy. Despite Kumiko`s insistence that this is how it should be, several members take issue with Taki`s decision.

episodes_data.title: Expressing Arpeggios
episodes_data.description: The Kansai competition is right around the corner, and the band`s dissent about Taki-sensei`s decisions only continues to grow. Kumiko goes to speak with him, and she has to decide whether to speak her mind.

episodes_data.title: Orchestra to the Future
episodes_data.description: The concert band receives its Kansai competition results. Reina and Kumiko see Yoroizuka perform with some of their senpais. However, Kumiko and Reina`s relationship becomes precarious as she continues to insist she won`t go to music school.

episodes_data.title: The Last Soloist
episodes_data.description: Taki decides that the band will choose the euphonium soli player by voting on one final audition. Kumiko then decides that they should choose based on sound alone, and so the two of them audition anonymously.

episodes_data.title: Connecting Melodies
episodes_data.description: The final competition for the third-years is at hand. The Kitauji High School Concert Band performs together one last time in a bid for National gold.
